correctness.rationale: Exact principal-downset weights yield a cone at time 0 followed by consecutive joins of whole antichain levels. Integral augmentation-tensor homology gives M_j free generators only in degree j−1; each inclusion to the next join factors through a cone, so births and deaths are exact. Degree-dependent bar lengths and multiplicities prove vector recovery; top essential births prove root separation and the exact extreme-root bottleneck formula. Standalone direct-chain reduction checked 204 root-prime cases; finite tests are corroborative only.
